subject.title: feat(ui): detect session pull requests and pin status chips above the chat composer

question: Should OpenClaw core automatically poll GitHub pull-request status for eligible chat sessions, or should this be an explicit operator-triggered developer feature?
rationale: Correctness fixes cannot determine whether a permanent Gateway API and recurring external-service lookup belong in the default Control UI experience.

options.title: Keep automatic core chips
options.body: Sponsor the feature as first-class Control UI behavior after the findings, conflict, and integrated proof are resolved.

options.title: Make lookup explicit
options.body: Require an operator action or opt-in so GitHub traffic occurs only when requested.

options.title: Keep outside core
options.body: Route the workflow to a plugin or external developer integration instead of default Control UI behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep automatic core chips
recommendation.body: Sponsor the feature as first-class Control UI behavior after the findings, conflict, and integrated proof are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged ownership spans the exact Control UI chat, Gateway method, and descriptor surfaces affected here.
